name: AE Employer Election Operational Dashboard
description: Working-team dashboard for Annual Enrollment: non-completed status detail (by region), stalled-time buckets, multiple-attempts/recent-completion activity, election-type/HSA breakdowns, and a daily timeline. Split off from AE Snap Report on 2026-09-13.

feeds.description: Status / Synod-Region / Election Sub-Type / Date / Year — same shape as AE Snap Report's employerStatus binding (both widgets share AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY); Election Sub-Type also carries the 3 operational row-kinds added 2026-09-13 (Multiple Attempts / Stalled .../Days, rescaled to 0-3/4-7/8+ on 2026-09-16 / Recently Completed) plus, added 2026-09-14, the Eligible Employee Band row-kind (20+ / 10-19 / 3-9 / Under 3 / Unknown), which is the only row-kind where Status and Election Sub-Type are both populated together. Date rows now carry Year too (2026 or 2027, added 2026-09-16) — Timeline renders as a YoY grouped table + cumulative pace tracker, same redesign as AE Snap Report's

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
